blocking: Language support is qualified in the FAQ but promised elsewhere as an included deliverable; Pashto appears in the inquiry form and Afghan copy but disappears from the service language lists.
The coordination proposal limits covered events, hours and staffing, while 'With either option' promises coverage across every day. Families cannot reliably tell what they are buying.

fixes.where: how-we-work.html — #you-get; shared proposal and footer copy
fixes.what: Use one consistent promise: 'Translated summaries and spoken language support are agreed before booking and listed in your proposal.' Apply it to Pashto requests too; replace blanket promises of both scripts and digit sets with the family's agreed languages.
fixes.why: Parents should know precisely which support they can rely on.

fixes.what: Change 'across every day' to 'across the events and hours listed in your proposal'; apply that qualification to staffing, signage coordination and post-wedding support.
fixes.why: The shared benefits currently appear broader than the coordination package.
